)
django.setup()
from django.db import connection, models
from django.db.models import F, Sum, Avg, Count

class Book(models.Model):
    class Meta:
        app_label = 'auth'

with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(Book)
Book.objects.bulk_create([Book(id=i) for i in range(1, 6)])  # ids 1..5, sum=15

from django.db.models.functions import Coalesce
qs = Book.objects.annotate(idx=F('id'))
print('A:', qs.aggregate(Sum('id')))                       # expect 15
print('B:', qs.aggregate(Sum('id', default=0)))            # expect 15
print('C:', qs.aggregate(x=Coalesce(Sum('id'), 0)))        # expect 15
print('D:', Book.objects.aggregate(Sum('id', default=0)))  # expect 15
print('E:', qs.aggregate(Sum('id', default=0), Avg('id', default=1), Count('id')))  # multi
print('F:', Book.objects.none().aggregate(Sum('id', default=42)))  # empty qs -> default
print('G:', qs.filter(id__gt=100).aggregate(Sum('id', default=42)))  # no rows -> default

q.add_annotation(Sum('id', default=0), 'id__sum', is_summary=True)
